reference.sourceTitle: U.S. Navy BuAer SBD-5 & 6 Descriptive Arrangement, 1 June 1944
reference.variant: SBD-5/6 main airframe used for SBD-3; variant-specific intake and sight retained separately
reference.license: Public domain, U.S. Navy Bureau of Aeronautics
notes: Primary retained SBD-5/6 drawing supplies common airframe, broad fixed inner wing, rounded tips and long curved dorsal-fin root; this does not certify an SBD-3-specific engine cowling.
SBD-3 upper carburetor intake and telescopic sight are explicit variant approximations; exact -3 cowling-panel stations remain unresolved.

No wing fold: the SBD had fixed wings. Perforated split dive brakes are a required visible distinguishing feature. Cross-sections, fillets and canopy curvature between measured silhouettes remain inferred.

registration.registrationNote: Source side view has horizontal engine shaft with landing gear in airframe-level attitude. Top/side longitudinal scale agrees; tail span label 17 ft 9 in.

sourceTransform.description: Reference original has nose down; transpose image so newX=oldY, newY=oldX; nose then points right.
